name: Chigasaki Ririko
source:
Faction: Taimanin
Skill: Starlight Tecnique "Super Nova" (Hoshi Ton no Jutsu "Suupaa Nova"), Star Tecnique "Neutron Star" (Hoshi Ton no Jutsu "Nyutoron Sutaa")
Artist: [url=/s3449]Mizuryuu Kei[/url]
Cards: [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/799c6812c208dd81fbde04524d0d807b.png]TM 2 Stars[/url], [url=https://s.vndb.org/sf/31/93131.jpg]TM 5 Stars[/url]
History:
Chigasaki Ririko is a Taimanin student of Gosha Academy and known as a problem child. 
She is a gyaru and easygoing delinquent. Rather innocent, but also rather lazy, skipping classes. She ignores the school rules, specially the dress code, and is rude to the teachers, or authorities, calling them without any honorifics or just nags.
Regardless of her lacking some fundamentals and manners, she is very talented.
[From [url=https://breezewiki.com/taimanin/wiki/Chigasaki_Ririko]breezewiki.com[/url]]
